description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Mox Amber.
Yomiji triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures or planeswalkers you control.
Repeat.
